children.name: tests.PlayWrightTests.UserFacingPortal
Chatbot
test_chatbot_forLoggingExercise
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Exercise, given prompt==Log my exercise for today, where I ran 5 kilometers and took 2 hours, and says 'NO' to confirmation message
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Exercise, given prompt==Log my exercise for today, where I ran 5 kilometers and took 2 hours, and says 'YES' to confirmation message
Verify multiple exercise data logged via chatbot should be summated for that day and displayed in Health dashboard
Verify user logs an exercise through the chatbot with both a duration and step count
Verify user logs an exercise through the chatbot with only step count
test_chatbot_forLoggingWater
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Water in oz, given prompt==I drank 39oz today, and says 'NO' to confirmation message
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log water in oz, given prompt==I drank 39oz today, and says 'YES' to confirmation message
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Water in liters, given prompt==I drank 1 liter today, and says 'YES' to confirmation message
test_chatbot_forLoggingWeights
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Weight in kg, given prompt==log my weight==68kg measured today, and says 'NO' to confirmation message
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Weight in kg, given prompt==log my weight==68kg measured today, and says 'YES' to confirmation message
Verify user can use habi chatbot to log Weight in lbs, given prompt==log my weight==68lbs measured today, and says 'YES' to confirmation message
Discuss.test_discussionReactions
Given I logged into web app as a user, when I do not have any discussions, then I should see an empty discussions page
Given there are discussion posts, when I view this post with none reacting, then I should see Like button in Greyed out state
Given there are discussion posts, when I try to react to this post by giving thumbs up, then I should see Like button changing to Blue colour with text==Like
Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, then 'No reactions yet' text should be changed to 'You reacted' with reacted emoji

Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, when I click on 'You reacted' section, then I should see a modal with all reactions details such as 'All' count, count by 'emojis', users who reacted with what emojis
Given there are discussion posts, when I try to hover over Like button, then I should see all the available list of emojis

Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, when I try to update the reaction with other emojis such as 'Clap' by hovering over the Like button, then I should see the Like text changing to 'Clap' and You reacted section
Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user, when I logged into coach portal and visit this user posts, then coach should be able to see posts with user reactions
Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user, when I logged into coach portal and visit this user posts, then coach should be able to add reactions to this post successfully

Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user and coach, when user logged into web portal and visits the post, then user should be able to see all reactions including coach's reactions and 'You reacted' text changing to 'You and 1 other' with respective emojis
